newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Sierra Pacific rating cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Sierra Pacific rating cut.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Friday it cut its rating on Sierra Pacific Resources Corp to market perform from outperform.
-- EVEREN cited relative price performance and the perception that the probability of a merger in the next 18 months is not high enough to warrant an outperform rating.
-- The six-month price target is $28 and the 18-month target is $28.75.
-- Sierra Pacific shares were unchanged at 27-7/8.
